verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for business telephony products, since self-hostable PBX systems exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Google Voice can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure. SIP Link only connects an existing carrier and equipment such as an SBC to Google's hosted service, which is an adjacent integration, not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
